title: Fitzgerald's Bar & Live Music Venue
venue_description:
Premier Live Music Destination

Fitzgerald's Bar & Live Music Venue has established itself as San Antonio's premier destination for live music featuring a massive 30ft x 19ft stage and a 4000 sq ft bar. The venue's commitment to showcasing diverse musical talent has made it a cornerstone of the local music scene.

The Open Mic Trilogy

Every Wednesday Fitzgerald's hosts what they call the Open Mic Trilogy - three distinct musical events in one epic day. It begins with the R&R Musicians Pro Jam from 2-5 PM focusing on soulful blues and southern rock in a relaxed afternoon atmosphere. The Working Class Open Mic follows from 5-9 PM welcoming all ages (minors with parents) and all types of performers including musicians and comedians. The trilogy culminates with the Open Mic Jam Night from 9 PM to 1 AM a 21+ event where the energy kicks into high gear.

What makes Fitzgerald's particularly special is their commitment to providing professional-grade equipment and support. Musicians have access to a full backline including Line-6 and Marshall guitar amps keyboards and a complete drum kit plus professional sound and lighting. A unique feature is the blue room (load-in room) where the next performer can prep and tune up before hitting the stage ensuring smooth transitions and minimal downtime. With a spacious 30-foot stage and professional sound and lighting performers get a taste of what it's like to play a proper concert venue all within the supportive atmosphere of an open mic.

Weekend Live Shows

Friday and Saturday nights feature live music from diverse genres including blues southern rock metal and tribute acts. The venue has built a reputation for booking quality tribute bands covering legendary acts like Judas Priest AC/DC Van Halen Dokken and Ozzy Osbourne. Both emerging local artists and established national acts grace the stage with the venue offering audio recording services for original artists performing at Fitzgerald's.

Venue Amenities

The venue offers free parking an outdoor patio for fresh air and a fully stocked bar featuring domestic premium and craft beers along with a selection of non-alcoholic beers and mocktails. Happy hour runs all day Wednesday with $3 Lone Stars and Wells $5 Jamo Jim and Jack and $5 Titos and Deep Eddy. The 220-person capacity creates an intimate yet energetic atmosphere perfect for connecting with live music.

Community Connections

Fitzgerald's has strong ties to the local music community. McLain Custom Guitars home to San Antonio's guitar doctor Rick McLain is located nearby and helps with open mic guitar issues. The venue also partners with local music stores and supports both local and national artists through merchandise sales and promotion.
location: 437 McCarty Rd Ste 101 San Antonio TX 78216

title: 502 Bar
venue_description:
San Antonio Music Institution

Since opening in 2012 502 Bar has been delivering an unforgettable nightlife experience in San Antonio. Open daily from 3 PM to 2 AM this intimate venue has spotlighted both local favorites and touring acts creating an electric atmosphere night after night.

Music Programming

502 Bar features live music Tuesday through Saturday nights showcasing a diverse range of artists and genres. Sunday nights are dedicated to their popular open mic hosted by Mikey Vibes starting at 9 PM widely considered to have the best sound quality for open mics in San Antonio. Monday nights feature karaoke providing variety throughout the week. The venue's 163-person capacity creates an intimate setting where performers and audience members can truly connect making every show feel personal and engaging.

Sound and Atmosphere

The venue is particularly noted for its exceptional sound system which sets it apart from other open mic venues in the city. This attention to audio quality ensures that both performers and audiences have the best possible experience. The bar maintains a clean welcoming environment with top-notch service and a clientele that appreciates quality live music.

Drinks and Specials

502 Bar offers a vast and affordable beer selection along with expertly mixed cocktails and craft beers. Daily happy hour runs from 4-7 PM featuring $2 Domestics and Wells. The venue also offers a reverse happy hour Sunday-Thursday from 9-11 PM with great beer and drink specials. All-day Sunday happy hour makes it an attractive destination for weekend visitors.

Location and Accessibility

Located in the 281 Bitters area at 502 Embassy Oaks the venue is easily accessible and serves the North San Antonio music scene. The bar provides a neighborhood feel while maintaining professional standards in both service and entertainment.

title: The Cove
venue_description:
Unique Community Destination

The Cove is a one-of-a-kind destination that defies categorization. This unique hybrid venue combines a restaurant Texas beer garden live music venue laundromat and car wash all in one location. Committed to serving SOL food (Sustainable Organic Local) The Cove has become a beloved community gathering spot in San Antonio's Central district at the Five Points intersection.

Live Music Scene

Music is central to The Cove's identity with live performances Thursday through Sunday featuring genres from blues and rock to jazz folk Tejano and beyond. The venue proudly hosts the San Antonio Blues Society jam on the first Sunday of each month from 3:30-6:30 PM with different SABS members hosting each month and featuring the best musicians from the area. Backline and PA equipment are provided for jammers. Performances take place both inside and on the outdoor beer garden stage with local and traveling performers from every genre gracing the venue. The Cove's commitment to diverse music programming has made it a staple for music lovers.

Food and Beverage

The Cove is justly famous for its fish tacos and offers an excellent destination for locavores and vegetarians thanks to owner Lisa Asvestas's commitment to sustainable food sources. The menu features organic locally-sourced ingredients with options including burgers salads barbecue and sweet potato fries. The Texas beer garden boasts over 50 Texas beers on tap along with wine tastings and a full beverage program. The kitchen serves quality food throughout operating hours.

Family-Friendly Atmosphere

Unlike many music venues The Cove welcomes families with open arms. The venue features a play scape for children ping-pong tables a basketball backboard for kids of all ages and even a dog run for four-legged friends. Covered outdoor seating with misters and fans keeps guests comfortable year-round while indoor seating with air conditioning provides an alternative. The laid-back hipster-friendly atmosphere creates a space where everyone feels welcome.

Community Events

Beyond regular music programming The Cove hosts special events including the monthly Zodiac Star Party (an all-ages free family-friendly themed open birthday party celebrating each month's sun sign) beer and wine tastings West Coast Swing dance lessons on Wednesdays and Thursday trivia nights. The venue has become a true community hub where people gather for food music and connection.
location: 606 W Cypress St San Antonio TX 78212

title: Jazz TX
venue_description:
Premier Jazz Destination at The Pearl

Located in the basement of the historic Bottling Department at Pearl Jazz TX has evolved into San Antonio's elite destination for jazz blues big band Texas swing salsa conjunto and Americana music. Envisioned by renowned local musician Brent 'Doc' Watkins this 3500-square-foot venue combines the class of an upscale jazz club with the grit of a traditional Texas dancehall.

Dinner Show Experience

Jazz TX offers San Antonio's premier dinner show experience a rare slice of entertainment where guests can enjoy world-class jazz while dining on sophisticated cuisine. The moody intimate setting features candlelit tables beneath chandeliers and ceiling pencil lights with a neon Jazz TX sign blazing red beside the stage. The venue operates Tuesday through Saturday nights with shows typically running from 6 PM to midnight on weekends. Reservations are highly recommended as seats fill quickly especially for special events and weekends.

Musical Programming

The venue features performances from Doc Watkins himself along with many of the region's favorite musicians. Programming includes classic jazz from artists like Frank Sinatra Duke Ellington and Tony Bennett as well as themed nights such as New Orleans Night Disney Night and Charlie Brown Christmas specials. The Midnight Set series offers a freer more unfiltered form of jazz after hours with a special late-night menu. Special events have included performances by nationally recognized artists Grammy winners and unique collaborations blending different musical styles.

Culinary Excellence

Under the direction of Executive Chef Nik Ortega (who started at Jazz TX washing dishes and grew with the venue) the restaurant has earned recognition from Texas Monthly for its surprisingly sophisticated menu. Signature dishes include blackened snapper center cut filets mushroom ravioli pan-seared scallops and almond chicken. The kitchen serves dinner during shows and Texas Monthly praised the venue for offering cuisine that exceeds typical club fare. Three mini brisket tacos and lemon truffle fries are customer favorites along with the freshly made crème brûlée with strawberries.

Cocktails and Atmosphere

Jazz TX features some of San Antonio's best mixologists crafting creative cocktails along with a selection of craft beer drafts and champagne. The intimate basement setting creates a transported-to-another-era feeling with exceptional service throughout the evening. The venue is wheelchair accessible with accessible entrances restrooms and seating. Cover charges are modest (typically $5-20 per person on weekdays) making quality jazz accessible to all. The venue seats approximately 200 guests in a cozy intimate configuration perfect for enjoying live music.
location: 312 Pearl Pkwy Bldg 6 Ste 6001 San Antonio TX 78215

title: Make My Day Lounge
venue_description:
Jazz Jam Session Venue

Make My Day Lounge is a music-focused venue located on Nacogdoches Road in San Antonio providing a comfortable setting for live music performances and jam sessions with a particular emphasis on jazz.

Sunday Night Jazz Jams

The lounge hosts regular Sunday night jam sessions from 7:30 PM to 11:30 PM led by Jackie Huddle and Company. These sessions welcome jazz musicians to participate in an informal setting playing standards and contemporary jazz pieces. The Sunday night jams have become a regular meeting point for the local jazz community providing a space for musicians to network collaborate and share their love of jazz music.

Atmosphere and Clientele

Make My Day Lounge offers a relaxed lounge atmosphere conducive to both performing and listening to live jazz. The venue caters to music enthusiasts looking for quality jazz performances in an intimate setting creating an environment where musicians and audiences can connect over their shared appreciation of the art form.
